result.title: How NVIDIA Runs Its Own AI Factory | AI Factory Insider Ep. 2
result.description:
In Episode 2 of AI Factory Insider, host Kaushik Shirhatti (VP, AI Factory, NVIDIA) is joined by Nic Borensztein (Distinguished Solution Architect, AI Factory, NVIDIA) and Jon Fernandez (Director, Enterprise AI Compute, NVIDIA) to go behind the scenes on how we operate our internal AI factory at scale.

What we cover: 
0:00 — Introduction & guests 
0:56 — What is an Enterprise Validated Design (EVD)
3:35 — Building & validating the full software stack with partners 
4:44 — Security in enterprise AI 
6:06 — NVIDIA IT AI factory success story
7:02 — Why enterprises go on-prem: ROI, tokenomics & compliance 
9:12 — Inside NVIDIA's own AI factory: the secure agent workspace 
12:47 — Origin story: how our AI factory journey started 
14:27 — Scale: 4 trillion tokens/month & 200M inference requests/day 
16:10 — Use cases across every function (and why everyone's a developer now) 
17:47 — Chip Nemo: AI for chip design 
19:05 — Agent harnesses, the perceive-reason-act loop & secure workspaces 
22:51 — What's next: confidential computing for on-prem frontier models 
25:46 — Key takeaways & next episode preview

result.title: NVIDIA and Japan: Building the Next Industrial Revolution
result.description: For 30 years, NVIDIA and Japan shaped new eras of computing, from PCs and game consoles to accelerated computing and now AI factories. Today, that partnership is building the next chapter: AI infrastructure, national AI, physical AI, and the golden age of robotics.
